meta.title: Romullo Sousa · Software Engineer
meta.description: Full stack Software Engineer, focused on Front-end with a growing interest in AI-powered applications.

hero.bio1: For almost 10 years I've been building software for the web, tackling complex challenges and exploring new technologies along the way.
hero.bio2: I like understanding how things work and, above all, <hl>turning ideas into things that actually work</hl>.
hero.photoAlt: Black and white portrait of Romullo Sousa

about.paragraph1: My story with development started before it became a career. I've always liked exploring technology, understanding how things work, and building my own projects. That curiosity is what led me to software development and is still a big part of what drives me today.
about.paragraph2: I started professionally working on web applications and, over time, <hl>Front-end</hl> became my main area of expertise. But I was never stuck to a single layer. Working across different products and teams naturally led me to <hl>Back-end</hl>, <hl>databases</hl>, <hl>cloud</hl>, <hl>infrastructure</hl>, and other parts of the development cycle.
about.paragraph3: Outside of work, I'm still that dev who likes to experiment. <hl>Open Source</hl>, <hl>Linux</hl>, <hl>mobile</hl>, <hl>WebAssembly</hl>, <hl>CLIs</hl>, and <hl>developer tooling</hl> have all been part of those projects. I also have a special fondness for <hl>UI/UX and DX</hl>, always trying to balance great experiences with <hl>quality, security, and simplicity</hl> in what I build.
about.paragraph4: More recently, that curiosity led me into <hl>AI applied to software</hl>, exploring <hl>LLMs</hl>, <hl>agents</hl>, <hl>RAG</hl>, <hl>MCP</hl>, and <hl>local models</hl>, both within products and in the development process itself.
about.paragraph5: In the end, I like technology, but I like even more <hl>building things, learning along the way, and solving problems that make me think</hl>.

items.description: Building and evolving products for the Justice ecosystem, focused on web applications. I worked on modernizing legacy systems, performance challenges, international expansion, and, more recently, initiatives involving generative AI, OCR, and document processing.

Development of SaaS products from Front-end to production, covering Back-end, databases, AWS, and deployment. Among them, a loyalty platform built from scratch that reached more than 500 customers across 12 states.
